welcome.title: Welcome to Billery
welcome.description: In five short stops you see how your master data become offers, invoices and PDFs. This navigation leads to customers, documents, the catalog and the settings.

catalog.title: Master data and catalog
catalog.description: Add your articles and services with price and tax rate here, your customers under “Customers”. When you write an invoice, you only pick them.

invoice.title: Putting an invoice together
invoice.description: Choose the customer, add lines from the catalog, save: the invoice is a draft. It gets its sequential number only when it is issued and cannot be changed after that (GoBD).

offer.title: From the offer to the invoice
offer.description: Open an accepted offer and take it over with “In Rechnung” (to invoice), without typing anything again. “PDF” shows every document the way your customer receives it.

equipment.title: Equipment and amortisation
equipment.description: Record tools and machines with their purchase price and link them to services: Billery shows how much of it paid invoices have earned back already. The templates tour shows how your documents look: right here or later under Settings → Help.

list.title: Your document templates
list.description: Templates decide how invoices, offers and cost estimates look. A new template starts from a style of the gallery or from a Word or LibreOffice file.

defaults.title: One template per document type
defaults.description: The default template of a document type applies to every new document of that type. “Als Standard” (make default) switches it; “DOCX” and “ODT” export the texts for editing in Word or LibreOffice.

tools.title: Design and blocks
tools.description: In the tools, “Design” sets logo, colour, font and margins for the whole document. Under “Blöcke” (blocks) you arrange sender, lines, totals and footer by dragging and set up every block on its own.

preview.title: Preview and placeholders
preview.description: The preview shows the template with sample data; a click on a block selects it. Texts contain placeholders such as “customer name” or “invoice number”: insert them with “+ Platzhalter” or {'@'}.

actions.title: PDF preview and saving
actions.description: “PDF-Vorschau” shows the finished PDF exactly as your customer receives it. “Speichern” (save) keeps the template, “Abbrechen” (cancel) discards the changes.
